description: SQL guard: single statement, read-only, table allowlist — Checks one SQL string (up to 20000 characters; PostgreSQL, MySQL, SQLite or generic) before an agent executes it: exactly one statement, read-only (SELECT/VALUES/SHOW/EXPLAIN without side effects), and every table it reads or writes on a caller allowlist. Tokenizer-level: comments, string literals, quoted identifiers and dollar quoting cannot hide a second statement; reports statement kind, refere

allowedTables.description: Allowed tables, lower-cased match: 'users', 'public.users' or 'public.*'. Unqualified and qualified names are different entries.

readOnly.description: Default true: anything but a plain read fails.

name: sql-check
